name: @riprap/remotion
description: @riprap/remotion — Remotion 4 video framework rendering @riprap/ui kit illustrations under the glyph clock. Videos under videos/ are local-only (gitignored); wav/render artifacts local-only.

scripts.studio: tsx src/cli/main.ts sync && tsx src/cli/main.ts score --stale && remotion studio
scripts.render: tsx src/cli/main.ts sync && tsx src/cli/main.ts score --stale && remotion render
scripts.build: tsx src/cli/main.ts sync && tsc -p tsconfig.json && remotion bundle
scripts.lint: tsx src/cli/main.ts sync && biome check src videos
scripts.clean: rm -rf build out public/audio src/videos.gen.ts src/video-tw-classes.ts
